jobs.title: Open Source Enterprise Sales / Alliances
jobs.description:
Open Source Enterprise Sales / Alliances

This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales and Alliances teams. Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals.

Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth.

Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area.

Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. They help craft solutions that enable our customers to be more efficient, solve more complex problems and walk the path with the customer to get the best possible results.

Reporting to Sales leadership, you will work across either a region or a vertical and you can bring your knowledge of previous customers with you. We are committed to giving customers the most knowledgeable and most competent partners in sales so that we can succeed together.

Location: We have remote opportunities available globally.

These roles entail

  • Advancing a deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Experience with negotiating contracts and commercial business terms
  • Building and expanding strategic relationships
  • Building and owning the strategy and the development of the sales engagements
  • Growing customers awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Delivering on targets, objectives and providing a voice of the partner and/or customer
  • Travelling both domestically and internationally to drive partnerships in person
  • Aligning and supporting internal Field teams to identify, support, grow and transact
  • Working closely with Marketing, Sales Engineering and Product Management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner and/or customer
  • Leading executive interlocks between partners/customers and our own leadership team

What we are looking for in you

  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve revenue outstanding results in our technological field
  • Experience with Linux and opensource
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, regardless of seniority of current position
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation with results orientated mind set and a high level of personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long and more regularly to meet clients and partners as required

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program including Health and Wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

jobs.title: Solutions Architect for Automotive
jobs.description:
Solutions Architect for Automotive

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Solutions Architect for Automotive to help our partners (companies like Mercedes, Ford, GM, Elektrobit, Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) and prospects understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to embedded. And we continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

Beyond an expected Automotive expertise, this career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Liaise with other Canonical's experts (mastering the Cloud, Kubernetes, Security or Safety, etc) to aggregate our collective knowledge into comprehensive solutions for our prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux, including demos and PoCs
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies applied to Automotive, if you want to play an active role in building Software Defined Vehicles, if you are curious with a will to learn how to leverage and adapt Cloud technologies to the embedded world, you will love working at Canonical.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience - Yocto or RTOS
  • Fluency in Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Relevant experience in the Automotive industry
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences

Additional skills that you might also bring (but not mandatory)

  • Experience with ISO26262 and/or ISO21434

jobs.title: Director, Talent Analytics
jobs.description:
Director, Talent Analytics

Our Talent Science team ensures that we follow an objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient process to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. With a data centric approach, we examine hiring data to create talent analytics and business intelligence to fuel our decision making on hiring. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science throughout our selection process.

Working closely with our Hiring Leadership team, who ultimately lead on hiring, our team ensures that hiring decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. 

We are looking for a set of leaders to support our team growth and to help drive our strategic objective outcomes. This role will report directly to the Global Head of Talent Science.

To be successful you will bring:

  • Analytical tooling to coach and lead the team
  • Experience of leading roadmaps and projects
  • Experience of leading others to achieve exceptional results

Location: These are remote based positions that are available across the globe.

The role entails

  • Leading a team to deliver against a set of strategic objectives, with focus on product design and implementation of our roadmap. 
  • Cracking the code on hiring, connecting performance outcomes back to selection methods to ensure we identify and progress exceptional talent.
  • Designing professional processes and frameworks, allowing efficient delivery of our agenda.
  • Coaching and mentoring team members to grow and develop skill sets specifically around analytical capabilities and thought leadership, developing training materials and documentation to support team members.
  • Driving and representing the team in the absence of the Head of, acting as a credible and trusted adviser and an inspiring leader.
  • Working closely with company leaders to understand, appreciate and communicate our vision for talent at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a people based subject.
  • 7+ years experience in a Talent function, with a deep appreciation of recruitment and selection and analytics that drive decision making.
  • Proven analytical ability to dissect and analyse data using SQL. Alternatively use Python, R, SPSS, or, possess the ability to run lookups, indexing, matching formulae with an appetite to learn SQL.
  • Exposure to BI tools (Superset is our platform).
  • Exemplary ability to lead and drive others to deliver, including exceptional project management and coaching to lead roadmap execution and delivery.
  • Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Advanced psychometric skills.
  • A deep understanding of human behaviour, in particular intrinsic motivation.
  • Experience of using Superset and/or Greenhouse

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Large Enterprise Account Executive

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

As we optimize our go-to-market strategy, we have segmented our sales approach into SMB, enterprise, large enterprise, and strategic channels. Our Large Enterprise Account Executive (AE) will build, execute, and scale our efforts in our large enterprise and strategic channels, with a focus on large group practices and DSOs in the United States (ranging from 50 -100 locations). The Large Enterprise AE will focus on a complex, executive sale to stakeholders across executive and regional management to win master agreements, pilots, and large rollouts. The Large Enterprise AE will have a pod for direct support including an Inside AE, a BDR, and a dedicated post-sales team.

This is a founding role scaling a core GTM channel for the fastest growing product in dental history.

What You'll Do

  • Qualify client leads through discovery calls

  • Identify and break into large multi-region DSOs

  • Identify and call prospective dentists' offices within the DSO portfolio, to stimulate new client acquisition

  • Serve as a key player and contributor to the direction of this growing sales team

  • Partner closely with an Inside AE to win Large Enterprise accounts via a hybrid approach (Large Enterprise AE to work top-down, Inside AE to work bottoms-up)

  • Meticulously track your sales activity using Salesforce and strive to exceed sales goals

  • Serve as a core stakeholder in defining the large enterprise and strategic sales processes for Dandy

  • Continuously think of yourself as a student of the dental industry and an expert on developing the Dandy value proposition for this segment

  • Work seamlessly with senior sales leadership to meet high-level KPIs and revenue targets

  • Commitment to continuous improvement and desire to learn new sales concepts via rigorous trainings

  • Ability to navigate through ambiguity and ramp up quickly with limited resources

  • Highly skilled and organized in Salesforce or related CRM

jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure

Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines. 

We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering data platforms. 

We have a number of openings ranging anywhere from junior to senior level. We will help you identify a suitable position depending on your experience and interests. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations.

Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones.

What your day will look like

The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of features of data platforms, not analysing the data in them.

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features
  • Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly
  • Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python
  • Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems 
  • Have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

You might also bring a subset of experience from the following, which will determine the exact role and level we consider you for:

  • Experience operating and managing data platform technologies like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Kafka, Yugabyte, Trino, Superset, Atlas, Ranger, and Redis
  • Experience with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • Experience with the public cloud or a private cloud solution like OpenStack
  • Experience with operating Kubernetes clusters and a belief that it can be used for serious persistent data services

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

jobs.title: Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH
jobs.description:
Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH

About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH: someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business.

This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win

  • Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to an executive sponsor, and spot expansion opportunities from day one

  • Grow and retain accounts once they are live: steer the overall relationship, open new business lines and country organizations, and make sure clients see lasting value

  • Lead relationships at every level, from claims and underwriting heads to CIOs, COOs and board members, and move them from first conversation to a defined business case and a strategic commitment to Taktile

  • Design and moderate executive workshops and steering meetings with insurance leadership teams, turning open-ended ambitions ("we need to become AI-native") into concrete, prioritized use cases

  • Shape and land account-level commitments (business case, commercial framework, executive sign-off), working hand in hand with the Account Executives who close individual deals, Solution Engineering and our Head of Insurance

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor our platform to each client's needs and turn client requirements into concrete solutions

  • Build and work our ecosystem in DACH: strategy and technology consultancies, system integrators and core system vendors who shape insurers' technology decisions

  • Represent Taktile at industry conferences, roundtables and client events, and help design formats of our own that bring insurance executives together

  • Bring market insight back into Taktile: what insurers need, how competitors and incumbents position, and what that means for our product, messaging and pricing

  • Help build the playbook for Taktile's insurance business in DACH as we scale the team

About You

  • 6+ years of total work experience, including 4–6 years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable strategy or operations consultancy, ideally leading client teams as Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent

  • Project experience with insurance clients; you don't need to be an insurance specialist, and adjacent work in operations, technical advisory or digital/AI transformation counts

  • A commercial track record: ideally you have sold or expanded projects as an Engagement Manager. Software sales experience is not required

  • Outgoing and client-facing: you enjoy being in front of clients and leading the conversation, rather than working in the background

  • You are comfortable in front of C-level executives: you can structure a difficult discussion, moderate a room of senior stakeholders and hold your own when challenged

  • Strong problem-structuring and business case skills; you can quantify the value of a use case and explain it to a CFO

  • Technical understanding: you can discuss how our platform works with engineers and translate it for business leaders

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations, and you are motivated by building revenue and long-term client relationships. High ownership, but a team player, not a lone wolf

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

  • Based in Munich or Berlin (Frankfurt or London possible) and happy to travel frequently across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This is not a remote role: you will regularly work on-site with clients, for example in workshops

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
Client Accounting Division Manager

About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure - Kafka
jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure - Kafka

Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a managed solutions for a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines (similar to Amazon RDS approach). 

We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering managed data platforms. 

We are looking for candidates from junior to senior level with interests, experience and willingness to learn around Big Data technologies, such as distributed event-stores (Kafka) and parallel computing frameworks (Spark). Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations.

Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones.

What your day will look like

The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations, with the mission of managing and integrating Big Data platforms at scale. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, backups and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of infrastructure features of data platforms, not analysing and/or processing the data in them.

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features
  • Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly
  • Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python
  • Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems, such as Kafka and Spark
  • Have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

You might also bring a subset of experience from the followings that can help Data Platform to achieve its challenging goals and determine the level we will consider you for:

  • Experience operating and managing other data platform technologies, SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, etc), similar to DBA level expertise
  • Experience with Linux systems administration, package management, and infrastructure operations
  • Experience with the public cloud or a private cloud solution like OpenStack
  • Experience with operating Kubernetes clusters and a belief that it can be used for serious persistent data services

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues twice a year
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Product Marketing Lead - Trade

Consensys is the leading blockchain and web3 software company. Founded by Joe Lubin, CEO of Consensys and Co-Founder of Ethereum in 2014, Consensys has been at the forefront of innovation, pioneering technological developments within the web3 ecosystem.

The financial system is being rebuilt on open, programmable infrastructure, and Consensys is helping power that transition. From MetaMask, the platform trusted by tens of millions of users worldwide, to Linea, the only 100% proven zkEVM rollup and an emerging home for institutional ETH capital, Consensys builds products and infrastructure that enable users, developers, and institutions to participate in the next generation of the internet.

Our mission is to unlock the collaborative power of communities by making the decentralized web universally easy to access, use, and build on.

Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet. You'll be exposed to new ideas, emerging technologies, and complex challenges that push you to stay at the top of your game while helping scale products and infrastructure used by tens of millions of users and thousands of developers across the web3 ecosystem. You'll join a network of builders that reaches the edge of our ecosystem. Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

About the role

MetaMask is the world's leading self-custodial wallet — and the primary gateway for hundreds of millions of people into the onchain economy. Our Trading features sit at the heart of that experience: enabling users to place a swap, a perp trade, a prediction market trade, or an investment in Real-World-Assets (RWA) with confidence.

We're looking for a strategic, data-informed, and user-obsessed Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the positioning and growth of these features. This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the MetaMask marketing organisation — sitting at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and long-term brand trust.

You'll report to our Product Marketing Director and work across Product, Growth, Brand, Business Development, and Partner Marketing to ensure every launch and lifecycle initiative is anchored in insight, competitive differentiation, and measurable impact.

 

What you'll do

Strategy

  • Define and execute end-to-end GTM strategy for features within Trading across global markets — from opportunity sizing and positioning through to launch and lifecycle optimisation
  • Partner with Product leads to shape roadmap priorities based on market insight, user behaviour, and growth potential
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Product and Growth, representing user needs and market realities in decision-making
  • Influence long-term product strategy and monetisation through competitive analysis, segmentation, and market research

GTM and product growth

  • Lead product and feature launches, crafting narratives that resonate with crypto traders and holders,
  • Drive lifecycle marketing initiatives that increase awareness, activation, and retention across Trading funnels
  • Partner with Growth and Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities within user journeys, translating insights into programmes that move key metrics — conversion, volume, retention
  • Ensure strong measurement and continuous iteration — every campaign should have clear success metrics and documented learnings

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Brand, Growth, Communications, Business Development, and Customer Support to deliver integrated campaigns that connect product value to cultural relevance
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders and manage timelines, priorities, and expectations to ensure seamless execution

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Germany
jobs.description:
Senior Solutions Architect - Germany

Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why you'll love this job

Redis has spent over a decade as the fastest in-memory data platform in the world. That foundation is now becoming something bigger: the memory layer for AI. Vector search, semantic caching, agent memory, session state for real-time applications. Every AI system that needs to be fast and reliable eventually needs Redis.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll educate and collaborate with customers to design Redis-powered solutions for their specific business and technical needs, including the new generation of AI-driven applications. You'll drive POCs, pilots, and evaluations, working hands-on with customers using one of the most widely adopted technologies in the market.

This is an early moment in that shift. Joining now means helping shape how Redis shows up in AI architectures across the region, not inheriting a playbook someone else already wrote.

The ideal candidate is a good listener with a talent for creative, technical solutions. You enjoy tackling a wide variety of technical challenges patiently and pragmatically, never losing sight of the customer's business objectives.

If you're a technology expert who wants to give customers the best possible experience, and you're excited about being close to how AI infrastructure actually gets built, this is the right challenge for you.

Redis hires for this and similar roles on an ongoing basis, so your application will be collected and kept on file as needs arise, subject to applicable law. Redis may not contact you immediately after you apply.

What you'll do

  • Help customers meet their technology and business requirements using Redis products, solutions, and services, including AI-focused use cases like vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and semantic caching.

  • Understand, quantify, and verify the business needs of customers and their specific use cases, from traditional database workloads to emerging AI architectures.

  • Work closely with customers' technical teams (architects, developers, PMOs, and C-level stakeholders) to ensure the success of every POC and pilot.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop account strategies and identify new opportunities, both in new accounts and existing ones.

  • Present Redis, its capabilities, and its role in modern AI infrastructure in a professional and compelling way that helps customers see the business impact and competitive advantage of the Redis platform.

  • Use customer feedback and insights to improve technical materials and best practices, while feeding learnings back to product management and R&D as the AI use cases evolve.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering (ideally database engineering) for enterprise software.

  • Hands-on experience with server-side software development and Linux.

  • Experience with scalable, highly available distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML application architectures is a plus (vector databases, RAG pipelines, LLM-based applications), though not required.

  • BS in Computer Science, BA, or equivalent work experience.

  • A team player with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Able to travel regularly to visit customer sites.

  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Compensation: The salary range for this role is EUR 105 000 to 131 000. Final compensation will be determined based on objective, job-related factors, including relevant experience, skills, role scope, level, and work location. This role may also be eligible for commission and Redis benefits.

jobs.description:
Responsable Scientifique et Technique pour le projet européen AMRIT

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le projet AMRIT : 

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole. 

 

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

Durée d’affectation souhaitée CDD de 18 mois dans les locaux de l’ENSTA à Brest. D’autres lieux d’affectation peuvent néanmoins être envisagés.

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny, 29200 Brest.

Le poste est à temps plein et comprend des déplacements en France et à l’étranger en fonction des besoins du projet.

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •  Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Informations complémentaires :

Le contrat est financé par la convention de subvention n° 101132013 du programme Horizon Europe de la Commission européenne « Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together » (AMRIT)

 

La candidature complète (curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation) devra être déposée avant le 27 septembre 2026.

Les questions concernant ce poste doivent être adressées à Laurent Mortier (Veuillez également envoyer votre CV, une lettre de motivation et les coordonnées de deux références dans le domaine du projet en français ou en anglais avant le 27 septembre 2026, à :

  • Margot Provost (Des entretiens seront organisés avec les candidats présélectionnés

    ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

     

    ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

     

    Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

    ********************************************************

    ENSTA (https://www.ensta.fr) is a higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of the defense. The school’s mission is to train civil and military engineering students, as well as highly qualified executives and PhD graduates for the public and private sectors, particularly in the fields of defence and security, transport, energy, maritime activities, digital technology and cutting-edge technologies.

    ENSTA supports the transformation of major national strategic sectors through its research, innovation and educational programmes, thereby addressing the challenges of national sovereignty. It comprises six teaching and research units (UFRs) which conduct applied research in close collaboration with industry.

    ENSTA is a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). As part of IP Paris, the school participates in the activities of IP Paris interdisciplinary centres, notably the Interdisciplinary Centre for Seas and Ocean (CIMO), co-founded with Ifremer and supported by the Defence Innovation Agency (AID) and the French research council CNRS. Researchers from the school also collaborate on studies led by interdisciplinary centres such as Hi-Paris – winner of the 2024 AI Cluster award – E4C and E4H, amongst others.

    Joining the school means becoming part of an institution committed to gender parity and professional equality, diversity and supporting its staff with disabilities, from the moment of recruitment and throughout their careers. To safeguard wellbeing at work, the school pursues an active policy on working conditions, based in particular on a healthy work-life balance.

    The AMRIT project : 

    Today in Europe, the operations of in situ observing platforms rely on a network of Research Infrastructures distributed all around Europe. The activities in the network include in situ and remote operations at sea and data management of a large number of assets for a wide variety of applications. Such activities rely on important IT resources, R&D to improve the capacity of the platforms, as well as managerial and financial activities to run the infrastructures and provide access to them. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) is a pioneering project designed to revolutionise the landscape of marine research infrastructures in Europe, strengthening their ability to respond to Europe's policy and global scientific challenges.

    AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) is a Horizon Europe & UKRI funded project, with 26 European partners, designed to advance Marine Research Infrastructures (MRIs). By developing tools and services integrating the operations of marine observation platforms, AMRIT aims to:

    •  Ensure seamless operation of marine observation platforms.

    •  Ensure the full nominal use of sensors and accelerate their evolution.

    •  Exploit the complementarity of the various observation platforms.

    •  Ensure the overall coherence of the ocean data value chain.

    •  Ensure a consistent and comprehensive list of metadata and descriptors.

    Mission of the Scientific and Technical Manager : 

    As third party of ARMINES, the administrative Coordinator of the Horizon Europe Project AMRIT, ENSTA is seeking a Scientific and Technical Manager. Under the supervision of the project Scientific Coordinator, Professor Laurent Mortier (ENSTA), the main tasks of the Project Manager are to:

    • Coordinate the overall implementation of the project and monitor its progress, including work packages, deliverables, milestones, deadlines and key performance indicators, in close collaboration with the Scientific Coordinator and with the support of ARMINES administrative staff.

    • Monitor project risks, deviations and corrective actions, and propose mitigation or adjustment measures where necessary.

    • Lead and coordinate the consortium, maintaining regular communication with consortium members, facilitating collaboration among partners, ensuring the effective flow of information and supporting partners in the implementation of their activities.

    • Organise and coordinate consortium meetings, including steering committee meetings, technical meetings and general assemblies, as well as their preparation and follow-up.

    • Coordinate the preparation of project reports and deliverables, consolidating contributions from partners and ensuring their quality and timely submission.

    • Contribute to the communication, dissemination and exploitation of project results, including through workshops and conferences, in coordination with the relevant partners.

    • Act as the main liaison with the European Commission, including maintaining regular communication and follow-up with the Project Officer.

    • Represent the consortium and build and maintain high-level relationships with key stakeholders at national, European and international levels.

    Required qualifications and skills :

    • Applicants must have an advanced university degree (M.Sc or equivalent degree) in Oceanography, Marine Science or Engineering, or related fields. A PhD in a relevant field is an advantage.

    • Applicants must have at least 5 years (PhD included) of relevant experience in ocean observations or services in ocean observation organisations.

    • Applicants must have demonstrated experience in coordinating, managing and implementing projects, desirably at the European or international level.

    • Excellent organizational, written and communication skills.

    • Professional command of both spoken and written English, and good knowledge of French and/or another European language.

    Desired qualifications and skills :

    • Motivation and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders on national, international (and interdisciplinary) levels including researchers, operators, administrative staff, science officers, and policy makers.

    • Degree in management of European affairs or similar.

    • Knowledge of major national and EU funding instruments.

    • Experience of working and collaborating among Research Infrastructures in the environmental field.

    Working conditions :

    ENSTA is committed to a recruitment process that promotes equality, diversity and inclusion. All applications, regardless of any distinction (age, disability, gender, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, etc.), are welcome in our recruitment process.

jobs.description:
AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech

About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

Why this role, why now

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

The mission

We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:

  • Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.

  • Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.

  • Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.

  • Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.

  • Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.

  • Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.

20%: studio radar and partnerships

  • Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.

  • See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.

  • Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.

  • Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.

  • Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.

Who we’re looking for

  • An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.

  • 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.

  • A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.

  • High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.

  • Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.

  • Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.

Recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner at Hexa

  • Interview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)

  • Coffee with team members & Reference checks

Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :

• Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
• Autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe.
