Senior LCA Engineer

👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Your core mission is to turn LCA methodology into software that works at scale. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability.

As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery.

  • Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features.

  • Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good.

  • Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories.

  • Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs.

  • Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case.

  • Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback.

  • Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges.

  • Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically.

  • From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly.

  • Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers.

  • Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Language: Business fluent in English (C1+).

  • Education: Bachelors, Masters Degree or PhD in a relevant subject, i.e Sustainable Energy Systems, Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) etc.

  • Languages: Proficiency in German, or any other of the following European languages (French, Italian, Dutch, a Nordic language).

Offre de stage – Design et fabrication d’un circuit électronique flexible pour capteur de gaz portable – 5 à 6 mois

English version


Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

·         Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

·         Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.

· Présenter une expérience avec les outils de conception de circuits électriques ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et qu’en compatibilité électromagnétique.

Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles.

jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description:
Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market
jobs.description:
Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market

Empowering organizations in IT risk management

Securance helps organizations build resilience and security, enabling them to provide assurance to stakeholders on IT risk management and cybersecurity. Based in Utrecht, the team works to structurally improve security for clients operating in the DACH market.

Your responsibilitiesJunior International Sales & Partnership Representative – DACH Market

Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student

📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands
🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team
🇩🇪 DACH Market – Germany, Austria & Switzerland

Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht.

Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career?

Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about?

Welcome to Securance!

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn.

Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

What will you be doing?

As part of our international team, you will:

  • Business Development: Identify potential customers, new business opportunities and commercial prospects in the DACH region.

  • Consultative Sales: Connect with decision-makers, understand their challenges and learn how to develop valuable business solutions.

  • Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations.

  • Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network.

  • International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

What can you expect from Securance?

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

About Securance

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

Location: Utrecht, The Netherlands. This is an office-based international team position, involving regular business travel to Germany when required. It is not a remote position based in Germany.

Executive Assistant III

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We’re looking for a resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support two Vice Presidents across our UK business and EMEA Technology organisation. In this role, you’ll help leaders operate effectively by managing calendars, coordinating travel and events, supporting meeting preparation, and maintaining strong documentation and record-keeping practices.

You’ll partner closely with teams in the UK and internationally, including the Affirm Leadership Support Team, and cross-functional partners across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP, Country Manager UK and the VP, EU Engineering

What You’ll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents

  • Manage inboxes, calendars, scheduling, and meeting prioritisation to help leaders use their time effectively

  • Co-ordinate core meetings in the daily / weekly / monthly operating plan for both leaders, ensuring attendance, drafting and distributing agendas, preparing materials, creating decks / notion pages, communicating with attendees and ensuring follow up actions are shared in a timely manner and tracked to completion.

  • Manage incoming correspondence, including email and physical mail, and coordinate timely intake and forwarding from the managed office facility

  • Ensure leaders are fully prepared for all core meetings that they attend linking all relevant documentation into calendar invites and providing timely reminders, blocking off time in diaries to ensure sufficient preparation and review time.

  • Co-ordinate team events, team-building activities, and onsite/offsite meetings in various locations, including travel as needed.

  • Ensure monthly in-office days are planned and well attended, including booking office space, organising food and refreshments, ensuring AV equipment is available and operational.

  • Plan and co-ordinate all travel for both VPs in good time ensuring tracking, monitoring and communication of any delays , cancellations and changes to travel plans.

  • Support and complete expense reporting and travel coordination through Navan travel system

  • Prepare documents and presentations using Google Suite and Microsoft Office develop skills of AI tools

  • Provide administrative support and coordination for UK and EMEA projects and programmes as needed

  • Pro-actively engage and develop effective ways of working utilising AI tools.

  • Work collaboratively with the support team across the business, providing cover where needed and ensuring cover is planned during planned time off.

What We Look For

  • 8+ years of relevant executive support experience

  • Experience supporting Board level leaders in a fast-paced, dynamic, and cross-functional environment

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, functions, and markets

  • Comfortable and proven experience of working in a remote environment

  • Complete discretion and confidentiality in all matters

  • Excellent judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information

  • Outstanding organisational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Experience providing clerk or administrative support for Board and/or sub-committee meetings

  • Experience working in or supporting a regulated UK business

  • Working knowledge of Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Navan, Notion, and Zoom

  • Working knowledge of workplace AI tools - Codex and Claude

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and lean into ad hoc projects and requests

  • Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive feedback diplomatically

  • Willingness to travel when required, including some international travel

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: H

Equity Grade: UK 1

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £61,000–£99,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

  • Proactively identify and resolve complex customer challenges, utilizing creative problem-solving to ensure customer satisfaction while leveraging insights to drive improvements.

  • Design, champion, and operationalize highly scalable processes that enhance customer experience, working in tandem with other internal teams to ensure operational excellence.

  • Drive critical cross-functional alignment with Tech, Logistics, and other departments, ensuring customer insights directly inform roadmaps.

  • Execute high-touch, multi-channel communication, engaging directly with customers via phone and email to resolve inquiries and provide a premium support experience.

Who You Are

You're a hands-on and execution-driven individual contributor with a proven track record of shaping outcomes in fast-paced environments. As a vital member of a small team, you're ready to make a significant impact on our customer success architecture and contribute directly to our disruptive mission in the DACH market.

jobs.description:
Visual Designer (Events, Print & Campaign)

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the role

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

Omnea now runs roughly one event every three days, across London, New York and beyond. You'll bring it in-house, raise the quality bar and build the foundations (templates, asset libraries, print specs) so every event doesn't start from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Founding Visual Designer, who owns digital (website, animations, product assets), building on a brand direction that's already set. Together you'll keep the brand consistent everywhere, from a product launch page to a booth at an industry summit, and help it evolve as we grow, pushing it into new formats, spaces and campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll take briefs from Marketing and Events, shape them, push back where needed, and see them through to production.

What you'll do

Events

  • Design event assets end to end: booths, roll-ups, signage, badges, invites, menus, stage visuals and merchandise.

  • Partner with the Events team on our own events (like our Annual Summit in New York), industry conferences and customer dinners.

  • Build and maintain an event asset library and templates, including a self-serve starter kit so colleagues running smaller events stay on brand without a designer.

Print and traditional media

  • Design print collateral and out-of-home or traditional media placements.

  • Prepare print-ready files and work with printers and suppliers on production, quality and deadlines.

Marketing and campaign design

  • Create graphic design for campaigns, paid ads, social and content, working closely with Marketing and Product Marketing.

  • Support product launches with campaign assets, in partnership with the digital Visual Designer.

  • Help Marketing self-serve by growing our brand asset bank and templates.

Presentations

  • Design high-impact decks for events, keynotes, webinars, sales and leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our slide templates so teams can build on-brand decks themselves.

  • Turn rough content into clear, well-structured presentations.

Brand

  • Apply and extend our new brand system across print and physical formats.

  • Raise the quality bar on customer-facing content, including guidelines for photography and filming at events.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the brand system inside out, you've shipped your first event assets, and you've mapped what currently goes to contractors.

  • First 90 days: events and print run through you, not contractors. There's a working event template library and a print spec/supplier list the team trusts.

  • First 6 months: colleagues self-serve the basics (starter kit, slide templates), and you spend your time on the moments that matter most.

Who you'll work with

  • Events: our Events team in London and New York.

  • Marketing and Product Marketing: a growing PMM team plus content, customer advocacy and growth.

  • Design: our Founding Visual Designer and the Design Director.

  • Leadership: occasional high-visibility requests (keynotes, board and leadership decks).

What we're looking for

  • Around 5 years in graphic or visual design, ideally in a B2B or in-house brand team. If you're close to that and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway.

  • A portfolio with real, produced events, print and campaign work, not only screens.

  • Strong typography, layout and colour, and confidence working within a brand system while pushing it forward.

  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with printers and suppliers.

  • Comfortable juggling several briefs at once, pushing back on scope and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

  • Strong presentation design in Google Slides and Figma Slides.

Nice to have

  • Basic motion design for event screens and social.

  • Experience art directing photography or video.

How we hire

  1. Portfolio review by our design team.

  2. Intro call with Talent Team (about 30 mins).

  3. Design deep-dive: walk us through 2 to 3 produced projects.

  4. Meet the team: Marketing and Events stakeholders.

We keep it quick and tell you where you stand at each stage.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Offre de Stage : Ingénierie des électrodes pour les batteries résorbables à ions métalliques – “Electrode Engineering for Resorbable Metal-Ion Batteries “ -Stage de 4 à 6 mois

Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.

L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

 

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

 

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :

Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.

Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.

Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :        

  • Préparer et mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode pour des systèmes de stockage électrochimique de l’énergie. 

  • Réaliser des mesures électrochimiques afin d’évaluer les propriétés et les performances des matériaux étudiés. 

  • Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation.

  • Présenter les résultats obtenus et participer aux discussions scientifiques autour du projet.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

 

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) :

·         Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, avec une formation en science des matériaux, électrochimie, chimie des matériaux ou dans un domaine connexe.

·         Bonnes connaissances fondamentales en électrochimie et en propriétés des matériaux.

·         Intérêt pour la préparation, la mise en œuvre et la caractérisation expérimentale de matériaux.

·         Une expérience en laboratoire, notamment en synthèse de matériaux ou en caractérisation électrochimique, serait appréciée.

·         Rigueur expérimentale, esprit d’analyse, autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe.

Global Senior Program Manager

Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. 

 

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. 

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. 

In addition, we offer: 

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. 

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.  

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). 

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. 

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. 

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. 

 

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.  

 

Furthermore, we are looking for: 

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.  

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.  

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.  

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.  

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. 

 

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch! 

 

Serious Tech 
At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues. 

 

We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement. 

 

Seriously you? 

We are looking for people who are energized by complex technology and are motivated by challenging work. People who take initiative, share ideas, and enjoy working together to make things better every day. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! 

 

For more information, please contact Nathan Seedorf via ----- style="background-color:#C6C6C6"> 

Interested in joining a fast-growing, internationally operating high-tech organization? Apply now! 

A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of our recruitment process. 

 

We do not appreciate unsolicited acquisition. No rights or obligations can be derived from the unsolicited submission of candidates by agencies or third parties without prior written approval from HR. 

 


  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.

Software Engineer Infrastructure

Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

Executive Assistant to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. jobs.title: Process Optimization Intern (f/m/d)

Process Optimization Intern (f/m/d)

Description

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is entering its next phase: with the start of production, we are evolving from a startup into an industrial company. This transition requires an operational foundation built on clean, lean and scalable processes. Join the CEO Office and play a key role in establishing this foundation. As a Process Optimization Intern, you will map our processes in Odoo, from purchase request to bookkeeping, streamline workflows that have grown organically, and automate manual steps. You will work closely with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on our daily operations.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Map our end-to-end processes in Odoo, from purchase requests and purchasing to goods receipt, inventory, manufacturing and accounting

  • Analyze existing workflows with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, identify bottlenecks and fix them yourself instead of just reporting them

  • Configure and extend Odoo modules, master data and approval flows, and help decide how the ERP grows with QD

  • Take projects live that make a visible difference in daily work, for example barcode scanning in goods receipt and warehouse

  • Automate repetitive manual steps with n8n and connect Odoo to the rest of our tooling stack

  • Build AI agents with Claude that read documents, check data and prepare transactions

  • Document processes and train colleagues so new workflows are adopted and stick

  • Keep data quality high and help set up reporting that gives management a clear view of operations

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field

  • You have experience with an ERP system, ideally Odoo

  • You understand processes in purchasing, warehousing, manufacturing, or accounting

  • You have experience with automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier

  • Experience with LLM-based workflows or agents, scripting in Python or JavaScript, or knowledge of SQL and data modeling is a plus

  • Experience in a fast-growing hardware or manufacturing company is a plus

  • You have a hands-on mentality: you implement things yourself instead of passing on requirements

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Business Development Intern

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Senior Product Engineer

About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product role with real scope: you won't be handed a corner of a system, you'll own complete product slices end-to-end, from spec through to something live that customers depend on every day. Here's a taste of what that looks like in practice:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, the action runs. Not chat over a database.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • An integration surface that reaches into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

You think in user outcomes and shipped work, not tickets closed. Your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day, and they'll tell you fast when something's wrong, which is exactly the kind of feedback loop that makes this job good.

What you'll do

  • Own product delivery. Take features from spec to production, frontend-first but covering backend and integration where needed.

  • Build the product surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work with AI in the critical path. Ship features where the model is genuinely part of the product, not a bolted-on feature.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. We deploy continuously, so you'll feel the pace immediately.

  • Have real input on what we build, how we build it, and which problems are worth solving next. Nobody here is precious about a roadmap someone else wrote.

What we're looking for

  • Independent delivery. You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision. Your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and solved real user problems.

  • Product trade-off judgement. You balance speed, quality and user impact under ambiguity. You push back when something is underspecified, and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship anyway.

  • Product taste. You notice when something feels wrong and aren't afraid to raise it. You care about the smaller details while still knowing when to ship at pace.

  • Cross-functional pragmatism. You work effectively with founders, designers and AI engineers, and you unblock yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

  • AI literacy. You're fluent with modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents). You treat them as collaborators, know when to trust them and when to override them, and have real opinions about where they help and where they get in the way.

Strong technical depth in:

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  •          la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  •          la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Au sein de la direction de communication, le titulaire du poste met en œuvre la stratégie de communication événementielle définie avec la direction de la communication et les autres directions de l’école, au sein de l’ENSTA et de ses deux campus, à destination des personnels, des élèves et des visiteurs des campus. Elle crée et fait évoluer différents supports de communication, numériques ou imprimés, et temps forts pour valoriser les activités de l’école et développer le sentiment d’appartenance à l’ENSTA et à l’IP Paris. Elle permet aux différentes directions de gagner en autonomie pour améliorer la diffusion d’informations. Le titulaire est également en charge de la mise en œuvre sur le campus de Pari-Saclay des actions de communication interne, en co-pilotage du pôle avec son homologue sur le campus de Brest, et en lien avec la direction de la communication.

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Paris-Saclay à Palaiseau.

Missions / Activités principales :

Sous l’autorité de l’Adjointe au Directeur de la communication, le (la) titulaire du poste sera en charge des missions principales suivantes :

  • Proposer des concepts, planifier, concevoir et gérer des événements (présentiel, à distance, hybride) répondant aux enjeux stratégiques de l’établissement

  • Suivre les demandes d’événements internes et externes, en lien avec le Pôle soutien à l’activité :

  • Vérifier la faisabilité des événements, disponibilité des salles, demandes de devis lorsque nécessaire (traiteur ou autres prestataires) dans le cadre des budgets établis

  • Réaliser tout support de communication relatif aux événements (visuel, mailing, etc.)

  • Conseiller et accompagner les organisateurs, animer les comités de pilotage le cas échéant

  • Coordonner les prestataires

  • ·Veiller au bon déroulement des événements (vérification de l’installation, suivi des intervenants, signalétique…)

  • Mettre en œuvre l’évaluation des événements avec des indicateurs précis et reporting

Communication interne (co-pilotage) :

  • Recommander et mettre en œuvre des dispositifs de communication interne pour accompagner le déploiement des projets stratégiques de l’École

  • Co-piloter et animer les médias internes dont les intranets et le dispositif d’affichage dynamique, le cas échéant, mener à bien les projets de refonte en coordination avec les services contributeurs

  • Garantir la bonne diffusion interne des mailings issus de l’activité du service et d’IP Paris via la plateforme Brevo

  • En lien avec la DRH, contribuer au développement de la marque employeur ainsi qu’à l’accueil des nouveaux arrivants

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Contribuer à toute activité de la Direction de la communication., notamment événementielles ou promotionnelles (forum, salon…) qui pour certaines se déroulent en soirée ou le week-end en fonction des besoins du service

  • Possibles déplacements entre les campus de Brest et Paris-Saclay pour des missions

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole .

Master 2 ou Master spécialisé en communication (CELSA, Sciences Po, école de Commerce, université...) et disposant d’une expérience solide (10 ans) en communication interne et événementiel.

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

Agent contractuel pour un CDD de 3 mois à compter du 4 janvier 2027 dans le cadre d’un remplacement d’un congé maternité.

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place de nouvelles formations d’ingénieur sur ses deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.
