jobs.title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)

Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling.

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare.

Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen.

Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken.

In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses.

In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer.

Als teamleider …

Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig.

Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team.

Als R&D Engineer…

Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten.

In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW;

  • Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken;

  • Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt;

  • Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren;

  • Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica);

  • Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie;

  • Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau);

  • Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden;

  • In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?


Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of .

Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

De teamleider is een parttime functie.

Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure. 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive - Netherlands

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

 

Every day, physicians across The Netherlands lose hours to documentation instead of patients. Tandem gives that time back - and clinicians actually use it. That’s rare in health tech, and it changes the way you sell: you’re not convincing people they have a problem, you’re showing them a better way to work.

 

We’re building the Dutch market properly - a real product with real pull, backed to win, and a sales team being built right now. If you want to contribute something being built for healthcare in the right way, this is the room to be in.

About Tandem

 

Tandem builds AI that gives time back to physicians, therapists and nurses. Our team of clinicians, psychologists and AI engineers builds close to the reality of care - pairing modern technology with medical expertise to cut administrative load and free up time for patients.

• 200+ people, founded August 2023

• $160m raised, backed by leading European VCs (EQT, Northzone, Kinnevik) and angels from companies like OpenAI

• Product already live and in daily clinical use across Europe in +10,000 healthcare organisations (1500 in The Netherlands)

 

About the role

At Tandem Health, we’re building a clinician copilot that gives time back to care teams so clinicians can focus on patients. You'll be dealing with complex customers to win them over and expand our market share in the Netherlands.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own the full cycle: qualify, demo, negotiate, close

  • Run a high throughput of meetings while keeping every conversation consultative, not transactional

  • Present the product to clinicians and decision-makers and translate their documentation pain into a clear reason to act

  • Manage relationships through to a live, happy customer, working closely with your SDR and MedOps

  • Stay engaged in your customer relationships long term, update and upsell them on new developments and features

  • Feed what you hear in the market back to product

  • Represent Tandem at events across the region

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales, previous experience in field sales, door-to-door prospecting, or territory-based commercial roles.

  • A track record of hitting and beating quota - and you can prove it with concrete numbers

  • The consultative, lead-from-the-front selling style described in “How we sell”

  • Native-level Dutch and C1/C2 English

  • Experience selling to healthcare professionals (clinics, private practices, care providers) or working in regulated environments.

  • Experience in digital products, SaaS, or technology that improves professional workflows.

 
 

How we sell (our culture)

We hire salespeople who lead, not ones who wait for a script:

  • You bring a point of view - you help a clinician see their documentation burden in a new light, instead of listing features.

  • You tailor the message to whoever is across the table: practice owner, chief physician, or administration.

  • You lead the conversation and put the hard topics - including price - on the table early, rather than hoping they don’t come up.

  • You are relentless about results and back what you say with numbers.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Leiden, your choice of IT equipment

 

Location & way of working

Netherlands-based · Hybrid · Fully Leiden-based preferred

Compensation

Competitive base + uncapped OTE

Applying

We building a team that reflects the world we want to change, and we welcome applicants of every background.

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.description:
Senior Implementatie Consultant SaaS, €4.250 – €6.000 | Breda

Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

Standplaats
Zoetermeer of Breda

jobs.title: Regional SDR Director
jobs.description:
Regional SDR Director

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are expanding our sales and field engineering teams globally, including our sales development representative (SDR) teams. Our SDRs and BDRs are typically outstanding graduates from STEM fields who would like to join the software industry and are starting their sales career at Canonical.

We are hiring Regional SDR Directors to run our inbound and outbound teams across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

Our goal is not only to manage inbound leads for a global tech company, but also to develop outstanding sales professionals with high integrity, high empathy and a rigorous work ethic. Our sales development organisation is therefore also a sales academy, and as such, we are looking for Regional SDR & BDR Directors who take a strong interest in the development of skills and the establishment of culture across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, hard-working, and care to ensure that smart and ambitious people learn and develop the skills they need to represent you and the company in outstandingly well over the course of their career, both while they are on your team, and as they move onward to more senior sales and alliances positions. You should be determined to grow your own skills as well as those of your team, and enjoy learning about new technologies.

Canonical is fortunate to represent the vast wave of open source innovation, which means it has a large and rapidly growing range of solutions it can deliver to customers, and ample opportunity for all of us to learn about new kinds of tech, or specialise in fields we enjoy the most. You should also be open to innovation, and experiment with new outbound approaches to adapt to changes in the market. In this role your primary objective is to direct regional SDR & BDR managers and teams across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, and maintain a multi-million dollar pipeline.

We value

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for business development, sales and technology
  • Track record of bringing exceptional outbound sales development results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Leadership experience of one form or another
  • Able to use data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Multi-regional strategic vision tailored to AMER, EMEA, and APAC market dynamics
  • Track record of recruiting, mentoring, and developing SDR Team Managers (leading leaders)
  • Cross-functional alignment with Regional Sales VPs, Marketing, and Field Engineering
  • Expertise in leveraging modern sales tech stacks and CRM analytics for predictable pipeline forecasting
  • Scalable talent pipeline management to feed senior sales and alliances positions across all three regions
  • Experience driving accountability and culture across asynchronous, remote-first global teams

Over the last few years, this team has trained dozens of talented tech sales professionals who now work at Canonical and across the industry. Meet some of the SDRs who have graduated from our tech sales academy.

What we offer you 

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical 

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer 

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (GOlang, Engine)
Infrastructure Program Manager
jobs.description:
Infrastructure Program Manager

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You are the bridge between detailed infrastructure planning and the single integrated master schedule that governs Alpha's delivery. Without dedicated infrastructure schedule ownership, dependencies like infrastructure readiness for the magnet factory (drainage, cryo supply, extraction systems) quietly fall behind because nobody owns translating detailed site-level planning into the program-level view leadership actually uses to make decisions. You make sure that never happens by accident.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and actively manage all infrastructure and siting project schedules across Alpha and Stellaris - buildings, utilities, permitting milestones, and site readiness

  • Translate infrastructure -specific schedule detail into validated, structured inputs for the Master Scheduler's integrated master schedule, ensuring infrastructure milestones, dependencies, and readiness dates are correctly reflected

  • Identify infrastructure -specific critical path items and interdependencies - for example, infrastructure readiness depending on equipment or magnet-line arrival dates - and flag risks early

  • Partner closely with the Master Scheduler, Risk & Change Manager, and Individual Project Managers (Alpha Construction Project Manager, Site Development Program Manager's team) to keep infrastructure schedules and the integrated timeline in sync

  • Maintain infrastructure milestone governance discipline across all programs, ensuring consistent coding and leveling conventions

  • Support gate-readiness by preparing infrastructure-specific schedule status inputs ahead of release gate decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in managing infrastructure or site development schedules on complex capital programs, ideally spanning multiple sites or projects in parallel

  • Comfortable working with a federated schedule structure - translating detailed infrastructure planning into a broader integrated programme view

  • Strong cross-functional communicator, able to align site project managers and technical teams with the Master Scheduler's baseline

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the permitting and contractor landscape]

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-scaling, still-being-built environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

jobs.description:
Product Director

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Director to lead product across a major surface area of the Omnea platform. In this role, you’ll set strategy, grow and manage a team of PMs, and ensure we’re building the right things - with speed, clarity, and customer obsession.

This is a leadership role that blends product vision, organizational scaling, and hands-on execution. You’ll report into the VP of Product and work closely with design, engineering, and go-to-market leaders to scale Omnea at pace.

What You’ll Do

  • Own product strategy and execution across one or more core product areas.

  • Hire, coach, and grow a team of high-performing product managers.

  • Drive product planning, decision-making, and communication across functions and leadership.

  • Ensure we are learning fast and shipping thoughtfully - balancing speed with rigour.

  • Partner with go-to-market to support onboarding, growth, and customer feedback loops.

  • Help define and evolve Omnea’s product development culture as we scale - including rituals, values, and operating principles.

About You

  • 9+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years managing PMs.

  • Strong product strategy chops - you can define vision, sequence bets, and zoom into detail.

  • Track record of building and scaling product teams in high-growth or startup environments.

  • You lead with context, not control - and you coach PMs to think independently and execute well.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to align stakeholders and drive clear decisions.

  • You care deeply about product quality and have a nose for what great looks like.

Why Join Omnea

Omnea is tackling one of the most painful and underserved areas of the enterprise stack — and doing it with taste and urgency. As Product Director, you’ll shape not just what we build, but how we build it. You’ll work with a world-class team that moves fast, sweats the details, and values ownership at every level.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

Senior Pricing Analyst

👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com

jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description:
Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

 

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

 

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

·       Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

·       Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

·       Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  •        Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  •        Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •        Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  •        Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  •        Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  •        Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Candidature complète : curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation et coordonnées de 2 professeurs de référence


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

          

 Connaissances :

·       Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

·       Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

·       Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.

jobs.description:
Founding Enterprise AE | France

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. We have a product already used by leading B2C businesses, but the French market is still at the beginning. We will earn our place, one customer at a time.

We are outbound first. As a founding Enterprise Account Executive, you will create opportunities, win major French accounts, and help define how telli sells in this market. You will carry a quota and own the hard parts of the deal, from the first cold conversation to signature. Your work will shape the playbook for the team that follows.

What you'll do

  • Build your own enterprise pipeline through thoughtful outbound, calls, referrals, and a deep understanding of French customer operations.

  • Lead complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, demos, business cases, executive alignment, security, legal, procurement, and negotiation.

  • Find the real problem behind a customer's interest in AI, quantify the value of solving it, and earn trust across the buying group.

  • Work closely with the France team, founders, product, and deployment colleagues to turn early customers into lasting successes.

  • Keep an honest forecast and turn wins, losses, and objections into a repeatable French sales motion.

What makes you a great fit

  • You have personally sourced and closed complex B2B enterprise deals, ideally in software or AI, and can show how you earned them.

  • You are comfortable speaking with senior business leaders and working through IT, security, finance, legal, and procurement.

  • You enjoy the unglamorous work as much as the big meeting: prospecting, follow-up, and fixing what is broken.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You communicate with confidence and care in French and can work effectively in English with our international team.

  • You are based in Paris and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding. You are ready to travel and visit prospects across France when needed.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You expect a ready-made book of business or marketing to build your pipeline.

  • You want to join deals only after discovery, and avoid cold outreach or the hard follow-through between meetings.

  • You need a fixed playbook before acting or pass on ownership when a deal gets messy.

  • You dislike working across executive, operations, IT, legal, and procurement stakeholders or learning openly from losses.

The reality of the role

France is a new market for us. There is no mature local playbook or book of business waiting for you. Some deals will be messy, and you will need to create momentum yourself. If you want ownership, direct feedback, ambitious colleagues, and the chance to do the best work of your career, this is the opportunity.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you sell. Approach it as you would a complex account: research us, form a point of view, earn attention, ask and listen, follow through, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the judgment and ownership you would bring to winning enterprise customers in France.

Compensation

€120,000–€180,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H

Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

  • Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

  • Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

  • Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

  • Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

  • Able to speak in concrete, specific terms about a real technical decision they challenged or questioned

Strategy / business skills

  • Ability to translate technical issues into business implications, and vice versa

Critical soft skills

  • Strong critical thinking and independence of judgment

  • Able to distinguish a genuine technical risk from a mere communication gap

  • Natural credibility: earns legitimacy through the rigor of the analysis, not through hierarchy

Success indicators (by month 12)

  • Technical capability map completed and kept up to date

  • A structured technology watch process in place, with regular outputs reaching R&D/Innovation and COMEX

  • Number of R&D/Innovation decisions meaningfully redirected following a well-argued challenge

  • Perceived quality of recommendations by COMEX and by the technical teams themselves

  • Measurable reduction in the gap between technical roadmap and strategic priorities

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You’ll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM’s and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you’re able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team’s goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
