jobs.title: Partner Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Partner Success Manager (EMEA)

Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Partner Success Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team, focused on supporting and strengthening relationships with our partner network. This role ensures Litmus partners are equipped to successfully deploy, support, and promote Litmus software using established Litmus best practices and processes.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll help partners understand Litmus product capabilities, adopt new features, follow deployment standards, and deliver a high-quality customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, partner-facing role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work with partner teams both remotely and on-site.

The Partner Success Manager reports to the Vice President of Customer Success and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partner, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

Travel to partner locations will be required.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary engagement contact for assigned Litmus partners, building strong relationships across technical, implementation, and leadership teams.

  • Lead partner onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to ensure partners are confident using and supporting Litmus products.

  • Educate partners on best practices for deployment, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout partner-led implementations and customer deployments, including managing escalations and resolving complex challenges.

  • Showcase new Litmus features, product enhancements, and platform capabilities to partner teams.

  • Identify gaps in partner knowledge, technical readiness, or process adherence and develop plans to address them.

  • Monitor partner engagement, deployment quality, and overall satisfaction.

  • Gather partner feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and product adoption.

  • Work cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering teams to drive successful outcomes.

  • Travel to partner sites as needed for training, business reviews, technical workshops, and relationship-building meetings.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in partner management, customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, training and enablement, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

  • Professional experience within manufacturing, industrial technology, industrial automation, IIoT, or a related industrial environment.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand, explain, and guide software deployment and implementation processes.

  • Experience working with enterprise software, industrial software, IIoT, IoT platforms, data platforms, cloud technologies, or related technologies.

  • Experience training customers, partners, or internal teams on software products and processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.

  • Experience with Wrike.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex deployment or process-related challenges.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

jobs.title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
jobs.description:
Electrical Distribution Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Finance Working Student (f/m/d)

Description

We are looking for a diligent performer, because clean books are the foundation of everything that follows. Join the CEO Office at QuantumDiamonds (QD) and become the backbone of our finance organisation. You will own your processes end-to-end and run them independently, from invoice intake to payment and the handover to our tax advisors. As a Working Student in Finance, you will keep our books clean, our invoices and expenses on track and our records audit-ready, handling day-to-day accounting with a strong focus on invoice processing, expense handling and bookkeeping. At the same time, you will help us improve and automate our finance processes as we scale from a fast-growing deep-tech company to industrial production.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Process incoming supplier invoices end to end: capture, check, match against purchase orders, and assign the correct accounts and cost centers in Odoo

  • Track open invoices and prepare payment runs

  • Align with suppliers and external partners on payments, open items and payment terms

  • Process employee expense claims and reimbursements, ensuring receipts and approvals are complete

  • Prepare and maintain clean records for the DATEV export to our tax advisors

  • Align with our tax advisors on bookkeeping questions and account management

  • Support monthly bookkeeping and closing activities, including reconciliations and follow ups on missing bills

  • Maintain supplier master data and keep our digital document archive organized

  • Support grant reimbursement tracking by collecting and organizing supporting documentation

  • Identify repetitive manual steps and help improve and automate our invoice and expense workflows

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

  • You are detail oriented, reliable, and enjoy working accurately with numbers and documents

  • You are confident in Excel, experience with DATEV, Odoo, or another ERP system is a plus

  • Basic knowledge of German bookkeeping (e.g. SKR03/SKR04, VAT treatment of invoices) is a plus

  • You take ownership: you run your processes independently and follow tasks through to completion

  • You are available for 15 to 20 hours per week and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent German and English is required

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 20 vacation days (based on a 5-Day week) plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Ingénieur de Recherche

Ingénieur de Recherche à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (F/H) :

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

 

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Début 2026, l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (UEA, i3-CRG, CNRS) s’engage dans un projet de quatre ans financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (AID). Ce projet s’appelle RésiCheVal (Résilience des chaînes de valeur). L’UEA s’intéresse à développer les outils permettant d’évaluer la capacité des filières associées à l’industrie de défense à résister dans un environnement géopolitique incertain où l’innovation technologique permanente est souvent une condition essentielle de la supériorité des forces armées.

 

Activités principales

L’ingénieur de recherche sera rattaché(e) à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée (UEA). Il est attendu des candidat(e)s d’être en mesure :

  • De contribuer à la production d’états de l’art sur les formalismes de théorie des graphes en matière d’étude des chaînes de valeur dans le domaine des biens d’armement.

  • D’accompagner la production d’outils d’aide à la décision fondés sur ces formalismes.

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

 

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Workforce & Business Analyst

Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive (Founding Team)

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Join Apollo as an Enterprise Account Executive (Founding Team). In this role, you’ll play a critical part in driving growth and guiding sales leaders and operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s powerful, all-in-one sales platform.

Role Summary:

Apollo.io is building its foundational team of sellers responsible for taking the company into the enterprise segment. In this full-cycle land, expand, and renew role, you will drive our growth into organizations with 1,000+ employees by acquiring new logos, retaining and renewing existing customers, and expanding accounts across your book of business.

As a founding member of this new segment, you’ll shape our motion, influence strategy, and set the standard for how Apollo wins in larger, more complex environments. This role is ideal for a high-performing seller who wants meaningful ownership, greenfield opportunity, and the ability to directly impact Apollo’s next phase of growth.

What You’ll Do:

New Logo Acquisition

  • Own a defined set of enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees) as part of Apollo’s first team dedicated to this segment.
  • Proactively engage Director, VP, and C-suite leaders across Sales, Marketing and RevOps to build qualified pipeline and close new logos.
  • Partner with the Outbound BDR team to drive incremental pipeline.
  • Build a repeatable motion for engaging enterprise prospects as Apollo scales upmarket.
  • Achieve 3X pipeline coverage and exceed new business acquisition targets.

Account Expansion

  • Mature your understanding of your customers’ business goals to identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
  • Build account plans that maximize adoption and generate multi-year growth across your accounts.Partner with Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers receive high-impact value that drives expansion revenue.Influence Apollo’s upmarket playbook by identifying expansion patterns and informing product and GTM strategy.

Revenue Retention & Renewals

  • Own renewals across your book of business with strong preparation, forecasting, and value-focused executive conversations.
  • Identify churn risks early and collaborate cross-functionally to drive adoption and prevent attrition.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships to ensure account stability and long-term success.

Sales Strategy & Execution

  • Use a data-driven approach to identify high-potential logo, expansion, and renewal opportunities.
  • Maintain precise pipeline hygiene and forecast revenue within a 10% accuracy margin.
  • Contribute to the development of Apollo’s enterprise GTM strategy through real-time insights from customer conversations.
  • Leverage Apollo’s platform and your outbound expertise to build meaningful relationships and position Apollo as a mission-critical revenue engine.

Mindset & Culture

  • Bring a “hunter + farmer” mentality - you’re equally strong in outbound acquisition and long-term account growth.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where processes, playbooks, and systems are still being built.
  • Embrace a collaborative, ambitious, and customer-first culture.
  • Operate with a builder’s mindset: resourceful, solutions-oriented, and motivated by being part of a founding go-to-market team.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying AE experience, ideally with both new business and expansion ownership in GTM enterprise SaaS.

  • Experience selling into enterprises (1,000+ employees) and navigating multi-threaded executive-level deals.

  • Strong ability to manage the full customer lifecycle from prospecting to renewals, while maintaining a strategic and consultative approach.
  • High degree of ownership, grit, and adaptability suited for a founding team environment.
  • Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation skills, and cross-functional partnership abilities.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer (w/m/d)

Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von unser Kund*innen. Dann übernimmst du Verantwortung und steigst in Pitch Prozesse mit ein. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber Lust hast dich schnell weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Bei uns bekommst Du 29 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wann und wo Du arbeitest, gestaltest Du flexibel: im Büro, im Homeoffice oder komplett remote in Deutschland. Firmenlaptop und passendes Home-Office-Setup gibt’s von uns dazu.

Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung und in Dein Wohlbefinden. Dafür gibt es Unterstützung für Deine mentale Gesundheit, ein Urban Sports Club und die Option auf ein Sabbatical, wenn Du mal eine längere Auszeit brauchst. Für Deine Zukunft sorgt die betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Dazu kommen du das Deutschlandticket Premium komplett finanziert.

Und weil Arbeit auch Spaß machen soll: Wir feiern regelmäßig zusammen bei Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Getränke und Snacks gehen auf uns. Dein Hund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen.

Vergütung

Unser Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position liegt bei EUR 77.500–90.000€ im Jahr.

Partner Sales Director

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

A strong partner ecosystem is crucial to the success and growth of Kong's business. Partners are a strategic imperative for Kong's continued growth and market expansion. As customer requirements become more complex, we need partners with the capability and capacity to help customers implement, support and grow their usage of Kong. We work closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure partners are integrated throughout the sales cycle, both pre- and post-sale.

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

Responsibilities

  • Own the partner revenue number for your assigned territory. Sell Kong's full portfolio (products, renewals, professional services, and support) through and with focus partners.

  • Build the joint go-to-market plan with your territory's sales team. Identify and sign new partners where there are gaps.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline: set targets, run the cadence, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable to them, favoring net-new sourced business over tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by coordinating deal registration, lead sharing, and co-selling motions for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect.

  • Build joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides actually use.

  • Run joint marketing events that generate pipeline, not just logos on a banner.

  • Get inside your partners' business: understand how they make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together. Pull in the right cross-functional support (enablement, CX, marketing, ops) to make the projects land.

  • Build a focus partner plan for your territory and execute it alongside sales engineering, SDRs, customer success, and marketing.

  • Partner with and Partner Sales Engineers to ensure partners have the technical readiness needed to sell and deliver Kong solutions.

  • Build, maintain, and manage relationships with the Kong field sales organization. Proactively engage with Kong AEs, ASMs and geo leadership.

  • Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of Kong team members, including sales leadership and support, as needed to meet sales targets and partner sales objectives.

  • Facilitate territory mapping and identification of new joint opportunities. Resolve route conflicts appropriately.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews (QBRs) within your assigned territory, and participate in annual planning within the Partner organization.

  • Provide weekly forecasts and/or progress reports, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and other partner management systems.

  • Escalate critical business issues to Partner Sales team management.

  • Prepare presentations, territory plans and reports as required.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales as needed.

Requirements

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the role, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market across channel, GSI, and hyperscaler partners

  • A bias toward net-new, sourced business, not just tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway

  • Comfort running many partners and many activities in parallel without losing the thread on any of them

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API/AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling motions

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems (e.g., Partner Portal)

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to remain calm under pressure

  • Established personal network within the industry

  • Results-oriented perspective

  • Interest in Kong and open source software; ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative (all genders)

The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails, and fragmented processes to manage billions of dollars in spend. As AI agents become capable of taking over increasingly complex workflows, the way companies run procurement is about to change.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Sales Development Representative, you're not just booking meetings.

You're creating the first impression of Lio. You're opening conversations with the world's largest enterprises and helping procurement leaders understand how AI can transform the way they operate.

You'll work closely with founders, Account Executives, Marketing, and Product, and directly influence how we scale our go-to-market motion.

What You'll Do

  • Generate and qualify pipeline through creative outbound and inbound strategies

  • Engage early-stage prospects and educate them on how AI agents can transform procurement operations

  • Run outreach across multiple channels including email, LinkedIn, and phone

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Account Executives to refine messaging, qualification, and handoff processes

  • Capture customer feedback and share insights with Product to help shape future features and improvements

  • Own your pipeline from first touch to handoff and ensure a seamless customer experience

  • Help build and continuously improve Lio's go-to-market playbook

Your Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership by default. You don't wait for instructions or permission. You make things happen, care about outcomes, and see challenges as problems to solve rather than obstacles to accept.

  • Know how to communicate and excite. Whether you're speaking to a Fortune 500 executive, a procurement leader, or an operational buyer on the factory floor, you know how to build trust, create excitement, and adapt your message to the person in front of you.

  • Enjoy high-growth environments. Things move quickly, priorities change, and ambiguity doesn't scare you. You learn fast, adapt quickly, and thrive when there's a lot to build.

  • Are curious about AI and excited about the opportunities this technology creates for enterprises. You don't need to be an expert, but you believe AI will fundamentally reshape how businesses operate.

What's not required

Previous experience in enterprise sales, business development, or SDR roles is not required.

We're much more interested in ambition, curiosity, communication skills, and execution than in having the perfect CV.

Why Join Lio?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Silicon Valley's most prestigious investor. We're bringing that same ambition, speed, and culture to Munich. This is a unique opportunity to join a company with Silicon Valley DNA while building in Europe.

We work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, working with C-level procurement leaders on large-scale transformation initiatives. From your very first day, you'll be exposed to some of the most influential enterprises in the world and play a role in how AI gets adopted in the real world.

We move fast, iterate constantly, and care deeply about execution. There are no endless approval processes, no politics, and no waiting around for permission. People here own outcomes and continuously raise the bar.

Joining Lio today means joining early. The category is still being defined. The playbook is still being written. Everyone at Lio is expected to take ownership, move fast, and help shape not only the business, but also the culture we're building.

If you're excited about building something exceptional, working with world-class customers, and helping shape one of Europe's category defining AI companies, we'd love to hear from you.

Opportunities like this don't come around often. If you're looking for a comfortable 9-to-5, Lio is probably not for you. If you're excited about building something extraordinary, we'd love to talk.

Any questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Cansel.

Kameras erfassen das Kennzeichen bei der Ein- und Ausfahrt, bezahlt wird digital, kontrolliert wird über unsere Software. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 ist unser Team auf 43 engagierte Mitarbeiter:innen gewachsen. Gemeinsam haben wir bereits über 94.500 Parkflächen in der DACH-Region sowie in Italien und Polen erfolgreich digitalisiert.

Was uns auszeichnet? Wir bieten eine ganzheitliche IT-Infrastruktur - von individuell entwickelter Hardware bis hin zu leistungsstarker Software.

Unsere Vision: Parken neu denken und eine nachhaltige Mobilität Wirklichkeit werden lassen.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest das Freeflow-Portfolio: die ANPR-Kamera, die Info-Displays Focus und Signature, die LED-Anzeigen und Leitsysteme, den Parkautomaten und unsere zentrale Kundensoftware ParkAgent.

  • Du baust die Roadmap und priorisierst nach Kundennutzen, Umsatz und Aufwand. Dabei bringst du die langen Zyklen der Hardware mit den kurzen Release-Zyklen der Software zusammen.

  • Du holst dir regelmäßig vom Vertrieb ab, wo Deals am Produkt scheitern und was Kunden nach dem Start vermissen, und machst daraus Entscheidungen für die Roadmap.

  • Du gehst zu Kunden, auf Parkflächen und unterstützt bei Supportfällen. Beim Flächenbesitzer mit zehn Dauerparkern genauso wie am Flughafen mit unterschiedlichen Kontingenten.

  • Du steuerst den Lebenszyklus der Geräte: neue Generationen, Komponentenwechsel, Firmware-Updates im Feld und Abkündigungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Integrationen mit Handyparken-Apps wie EasyPark und Parkster, mit Automatenanbietern, Enforcement und Halternachverfolgung und entscheidest, welche Partner wir als Nächstes anbinden.

  • Du erarbeitest mit dem Go-to-Market Lead Preise und Pakete, unterstützt den Vertrieb bei Ausschreibungen und bereitest Produkteinführungen mit Marketing und Customer Success vor.

Du berichtest an unseren Go-to-Market Lead Freeflow, der den Bereich mit Vertrieb, Projekt- und Produktmanagement führt. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr dafür, dass unser Produkt bestmöglich zu Flächenbesitzern und Parkraumbewirtschaftern passt. Bei der Umsetzung arbeitest du eng mit unserem Head of TechDev und der Entwicklung zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, davon einen guten Teil mit vernetzter Hardware im Feld plus Software. Wenn du bisher nur Apps oder reine SaaS-Produkte verantwortet hast, passt diese Stelle nicht.

  • Ein technisches Studium, etwa Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder einen vergleichbaren Werdegang.

  • Genug Software-Verständnis, um mit Entwickler:innen über APIs, Datenmodelle und Architektur zu diskutieren und Aufwände realistisch einzuschätzen.

  • Erfahrung damit, was Hardware anders macht: Stücklisten, Lieferzeiten, Komponentenabkündigungen und ein Gerät an einem Standort, das man nicht einfach neu ausrollt.

  • Die Bereitschaft, Prioritäten zu setzen und sie gegenüber Vertrieb, Kunden und Geschäftsführung zu vertreten, auch wenn nicht alle zufrieden sind.

  • Ideal ist Erfahrung mit Kennzeichenerfassung (ANPR/LPR), Videoanalyse oder Parktechnologie. Fehlt dir das, der Rest passt aber, bewirb dich trotzdem. Das Fachwissen bekommst du bei uns.

Benefits

  • Wir sind zwar kein Start-up mehr, sondern können uns stolz als KMU bezeichnen, den ursprünglichen Spirit haben wir aber längst nicht verloren. Du machst bei uns den Unterschied und hast die Möglichkeit dich in deiner Kreativität voll zu entfalten und deine Eigeninitiative aufleben zu lassen.

  • Eine hybride Arbeitswelt mit mobilem Arbeiten und zugleich kreativem Austausch im Office. Du entscheidest was zu dir am besten passt. Zudem kannst du dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel einteilen.

  • Ob Halloween Party, Stadt Rallye oder Schafe hüten, bei unseren zahlreichen Teamevents ist für jeden etwas dabei. Ohne unser Team funktioniert nichts.

  • Mit unseren Corporate-Benefits hast du die Möglichkeit bei vielen Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Branchen Rabatte zu erhalten.

  • Um dich im Alter zu unterstützen bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Ob Windows oder Mac, du entscheidest mit welchem Equipment du ausgestattet werden möchtest.

  • Mit Probonio hast du die Wahl: das Deutschlandticket oder ein monatliches Budget von 50 Euro, das du flexibel einsetzt, sei es für Gutscheine oder für den Urban Sports Club.

  • Du liebst Hunde? Wir auch! Deshalb kannst du deinen 4-Beiner gerne mit ins Office nehmen.

  • It's Time for Yoga! Einmal pro Woche kannst du bei unserer Office-Yoga-Session abschalten, durchatmen und neue Energie tanken - direkt im Büro und gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Produkte, die du anfassen kannst: Kameras, Displays und Automaten aus eigener Entwicklung und über 3.000 Geräte im Feld, deren Daten zeigen, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du hast bei (fast) allen Punkten ein Häkchen gesetzt? Prima!

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Head of VIP, Influencers & PR
jobs.description:
Head of VIP, Influencers & PR

About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, we’re looking for a Head of VIP, Influencers & PR to build TALA’s profile, cultural relevance and desirability through the people, partnerships, moments and conversations that matter.

You’ll lead the strategy across VIP partnerships, Influencers, Ambassadors, Pro, PR, gifting and events, turning TALA into a brand that people see, talk about and want to be part of.

You’ll know and understand that the fastest way to build awareness is to put TALA in the right hands, in the right places, with the right people.

The successful candidate will bring a serious black book of relevant VIPs from celebrities and musicians to stylists, athletes, creators and cultural tastemakers and know how to build genuine relationships with them.

You’ll be responsible for creating the moments that make TALA feel bigger, more culturally relevant and impossible to ignore.

Tasks

What You’ll Own

VIP & Cultural Partnerships

  • Build and own TALA’s VIP strategy, identifying the people who can meaningfully increase awareness, desirability and cultural relevance.
  • Develop relationships with celebrities, musicians, stylists, athletes, tastemakers and influential cultural figures.
  • Bring a strong existing network and continually build TALA’s VIP black book.
  • Create strategic partnerships that go beyond gifting from organic product placement to collaborations, appearances and brand moments.
  • Ensure TALA is consistently seen on the right people, in the right places and at the right cultural moments.

Ambassador & Pro Programmes

  • Own the strategy, vision and evolution of TALA’s Ambassador and Pro programmes.
  • Define the role these programmes play within TALA’s broader brand and awareness strategy, including who we want to attract, why they matter and what we want them to deliver.
  • Establish the programme proposition, structure, tiers, criteria and long-term growth strategy.
  • Together with the team, build a best-in-class network of ambassadors and professional athletes who genuinely align with TALA and can become powerful advocates for the brand.
  • Set the strategic direction for recruitment, relationship development, activation and retention, with the team responsible for day-to-day programme management and execution.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the programmes based on KPIs including brand impact, reach, engagement and commercial contribution.

Influencer

  • Own the overall influencer strategy, defining how influencer partnerships drive awareness, cultural relevance, desirability and growth.
  • Set the direction for the talent TALA works with, from high-profile creators and cultural tastemakers to emerging talent and community voices.
  • Identify opportunities to move beyond traditional influencer activity into cultural partnerships, organic product placement and high-impact moments.
  • Ensure influencer strategy is integrated with VIP, Ambassador, Pro, PR, gifting, social and campaign activity.
  • Set clear KPIs and continuously evolve the strategy based on performance and cultural opportunity.

Gifting

  • Own the strategic direction for TALA gifting, transforming it from a reactive PR function into a significant awareness and brand-building engine.
  • Together with the team, define who TALA should be gifting, when, why and what we want gifting to achieve.
  • Oversee the strategy for key product launches, cultural moments, VIP gifting, stylist seeding and wider brand moments.
  • Lead the team in developing, signing off and executing gifting programmes, ensuring activity ladders back to wider brand and campaign priorities.

PR

  • Together with the Brand Marketing Director own the overall PR strategy and communications agenda for TALA.
  • Define the role of PR within the wider brand strategy and how it will contribute to building fame, credibility and awareness.
  • Set the annual PR strategy, priorities, narratives and key cultural moments, working closely with Brand Marketing, Social, Influencer and Product.
  • Brief the PR agency to establish the types of stories TALA should be known for and proactively identify opportunities to create news rather than simply respond to it.
  • Ensure the PR team and agency has a clear roadmap and empower them to execute against it.

Events & Experiences

  • Own the TALA events and experiences strategy, defining how physical brand experiences can drive awareness, desirability, community and growth.
  • Set the annual events strategy, including the role of VIP events, consumer experiences, cultural moments, product launches, retail activations and larger-scale brand moments.
  • Define what makes a TALA experience distinctive and ensure every activation is rooted in the brand and designed to generate impact beyond the room.
  • Identify and feed into the events team opportunities for TALA to create culturally relevant moments that can extend into PR, social and organic conversation.
  • Oversee the brief and objectives for key events, with the team responsible for planning and delivering the experience.
  • Oversee the evaluation of the effectiveness of events against awareness, reach, brand impact and commercial objectives, continually evolving the approach.

Requirements

About You

We’re looking for someone who is highly connected, culturally switched-on and relentlessly ambitious.

You will likely have:

  • Significant experience across VIP, celebrity, influencers, PR and events within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or a culturally relevant consumer brand.
  • A strong existing network of VIPs, stylists, agents, managers, media and cultural tastemakers.
  • A proven ability to build authentic relationships with high-profile talent.
  • Experience creating campaigns and moments that generate significant awareness and organic conversation.
  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, understanding that awareness must ultimately contribute to brand and business growth.
  • A strong understanding of culture, fashion, music, TV, sport, entertainment and what makes people talk.
  • An instinct for what feels cool, relevant and TALA.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills.
  • The confidence to challenge the status quo and create ideas that haven't been done before.
  • A highly proactive, entrepreneurial approach, you’ll spot opportunities rather than wait for a brief.
  • The ability to operate at both strategic and executional level, from defining the annual VIP strategy to picking up the phone to a stylist.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • TALA is increasingly seen on the right people.
  • We have a strong and growing network of A-list and culturally relevant VIPs who genuinely want to wear and engage with TALA.
  • TALA becomes a brand that celebrities, stylists and cultural tastemakers actively want to be associated with.
  • Our Ambassador and Pro programmes become recognised as some of the most exciting programmes in the category.
  • Gifting creates genuine organic reach, conversation and product desire.
  • Our events become moments people want to attend and talk about.
  • TALA earns more high-quality PR and cultural coverage.
  • We create moments that travel across social, PR and culture, delivering awareness well beyond the original activation.
  • Most importantly, you help move TALA from a brand people discover on social media to a brand people know, recognise and want.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre !

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

jobs.title: Founding Enterprise BDR | France
jobs.description:
Founding Enterprise BDR | France

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference.

We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook.

What you'll do

  • Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve.

  • Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role.

  • Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use.

  • Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly.

  • Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging.

What makes you a great fit

  • You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection.

  • You speak clearly, listen closely, are curious about how businesses work, and are willing to learn a technical product. You are comfortable picking up the phone.

  • You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar.

  • You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You speak and write excellent French, work comfortably in English, are based in Paris, and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You need inbound leads, a finished script, or detailed direction before you can start.

  • You avoid the phone or repeated outreach.

  • You resist coaching or let a string of no's stop you from trying a better approach.

  • You value meeting counts over understanding whether a prospect has a real problem and reason to act.

The reality of the role

You will be one of the first people building telli's presence in France. There is no mature local demand engine or perfect script to inherit. Outbound is the core of this role, and some ideas will fail. You will make a lot of calls, learn fast, and help turn an early market into a repeatable business. If that sounds like the best challenge of your career, we want to meet you.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you open doors. Show us how you prepare, earn a first conversation, ask and listen, follow up, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the discipline and judgment you would bring to building pipeline in France.

Compensation

€60,000–€80,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
jobs.description:
Software Engineer - Optimisation Team

Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht


About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead.

We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact.


The Role

The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day.

Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems.

Success in this role means being able to:

  • Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code.

  • Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering.

What you will do

  • Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan.

  • Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from.

  • Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle.

  • Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing.

  • Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses..


What are looking for

  • 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code.

  • A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code.

  • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't.

  • Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required.

  • Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours 

  • Coming into the office 3-4 days per week


Bonus points for

None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around.

  • Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience..

  • Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest.

  • Data analysis experience

  • Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets.

  • The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team.


Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.


What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

  • iwell is a family-friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities


Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/.

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you a true iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two interviews. For the second interview,, you will also be asked to work on a case.

Acquisition based on this vacancy is not appreciated.

Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).

  • Free BetterHelp membership to support your own well-being
  • Additional bonuses and incentives for eligible high performers

  • Access to a community of 30,000+ therapists

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for independently licensed mental health therapists, counselors, clinical social workers, marriage and family therapists, and psychologists who can provide therapy without supervision.

Depending on your state of licensure, eligible licenses may include:

Clinical Social Work
LCSW, LICSW, LSCSW, LISW, LISW-S, LISW-CP, LCSW-C, LCSW-R, LCSW-BACS, MSLCSW

Professional & Mental Health Counseling

Marriage & Family Therapy

Psychology
Licensed Psychologist, Clinical Psychologist, PsyD, PhD, LCP, LPP, MSPSY, Medical Psychologist, Senior Psychological Examiner, LPA-IP, Psychologist – Master's, Psychologist – Doctorate

License eligibility varies by state. Your license must allow you to independently provide mental health therapy without supervision.

Requirements

  • Master's or Doctorate degree in Counseling, Psychology, Social Work, Marriage & Family Therapy, or another eligible mental health discipline
  • Current independent clinical license that allows you to provide therapy without supervision
  • 3+ years of mental health counseling experience
  • Currently residing in the United States
  • Professional liability insurance
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Private, professional environment for virtual sessions
  • Strong written communication skills

Focus on Therapy. We'll Help With the Rest.

Apply today to learn more about joining the BetterHelp therapist network.

*To qualify for the $1,000 First Client Bonus, therapists must be licensed in California and see their first client within 30 days of submitting their application. Therapists licensed in other eligible states who meet the same 30-day requirement may qualify for a $500 First Client Bonus. Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes.   • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

  • Own relationship during initial onboarding phase for new Pros including account activation and transition, adoption and product utilization, relationship building, and delivery of product and service value
  • Serve as the primary and dedicated resource for Pros during their early lifecycle, ensuring a smooth transition from sales through onboarding
  • Reinforce and “resell” the value of HCP, helping Pros build confidence in their decision and driving early product adoption
  • Effectively communicate client information, trends, and feedback across teams (i.e. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Tech Support)
  • Partner cross-functionally to support Pro success, especially collaborating with Account Managers to mitigate risk, drive retention, and ensure long-term growth
  • Develop, prepare, and nurture our Pros for advocacy, using a consultative and empathetic approach
  • Identify opportunities for expansion, recommend areas for improvement, and proactively look for ways to better our Pros experience
  • Manage details, timelines, and action to drive efficiency
  • Improve our Pros opportunities by leveraging qualitative and quantitative analysis
  • Develop processes that distinguish our brand by exceeding customer expectations in support delivery
  • Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions

Qualifications:

  • 1-3+ years experience in full-time customer success, implementation or sales
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
  • Proven success in developing relationships with new customers and exceeding success metrics
  • Ability to work the scheduled shifts: Monday - Friday 11am-8pm PST
  • Advanced English proficiency

What Will Help You Succeed:

  • Self-starter with motivation, drive, and ability to work in a fast paced environment
  • Strong problem solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prompt attention to detail
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Experience using AI tools to increase quality and efficiency of work
  • A natural curiosity backed by action; you are multi-dimensional (volunteering, creative outlets, side projects, hobbies, athletics), with a proven ability to successfully start over, learn from scratch, and thrive in new environments

Location Dependent Information

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.
